scope: Directed critical update of the 2026-10-14 review plus immediately relevant HTR methodology; not an exhaustive systematic review.

sources.title: The Beinecke Cipher (Voynich) Manuscript
sources.contribution: Custody, digitized images and undeciphered-script status.
sources.limit: Catalog dating wording and material dating must be distinguished; no evaluation of a proposed key.

sources.title: The Naibbe cipher: a substitution cipher that encrypts Latin and Italian as Voynich Manuscript-like ciphertext
sources.access: Publisher abstract, author explanation and repository description; not a new full replication
sources.contribution: Historically plausible constructed cipher reproduces several statistical properties.
sources.limit: Compatibility does not recover the manuscript key or plaintext.

sources.title: Evidence of Layered Positional and Directional Constraints in the Voynich Manuscript: Implications for Cipher-Like Structure
sources.contribution: Directional and boundary signatures; tests two generator classes.
sources.limit: Failure of those classes does not reject every generator or identify language or reading direction.

sources.title: A Glyph Is Not a Letter, a Token Is Not a Word, a Space Is Not a Space: What the Units of Voynichese Are Not
sources.access: HTML methods, limits and reproducibility sections
sources.contribution: Tests units and boundaries using prose/cipher/pseudotext controls, quire resampling and image coordinates.
sources.limit: Restrictions are conditional on tested representations and controls; no lexical meanings.

sources.title: Singulion Structure and the Voynich Manuscript
sources.access: Bibliographic record and prior documented author explanation; direct full text blocked by Anubis in this update
sources.limit: No new claim to have read or replicated its full ordering tables; reordering is not translation.

sources.title: Archetype: Voynich Palaeography
sources.status: Zenodo dataset, supplement to an author preprint
sources.access: Dataset record and full README; accompanying paper URL returned 502
sources.contribution: 1684 annotated graphs, 203 images and five allograph categories; eight section/hand labels map onto five proposed scribes.
sources.limit: Not eight proven historical scribes or a complete word-level ground-truth corpus. No images or labels imported into this retraining.

sources.title: Structural Decipherment Without Lexical Recovery: A Cross-Validated Morphological Analysis of the Voynich Manuscript
sources.access: Record and detailed abstract; linked PDF retrieval failed
sources.contribution: Author reports morphological/core structure and protected tests; explicitly separates role-naturalization from plaintext.
sources.limit: 98.4314% is a conditional role benchmark, not translation accuracy. Claims not independently reproduced here.

sources.title: Voynich Spatial Data
sources.access: README, VERSION.json and commit date verified
sources.contribution: 539 positioned/oriented Rosettes tokens and raw traces; spatial data CC BY 4.0.
sources.limit: Transliteration derives from community sources; Latin interpretation excluded. Font has distinct restrictions. Not imported into this experiment.

sources.title: On the Generalization of Handwritten Text Recognition Models
sources.access: Full HTML experimental methods and OOD analysis
sources.contribution: 336 OOD cases across eight models, seven datasets and five languages; lexical divergence matters strongly.
sources.limit: Known-language line benchmarks do not validate Voynich; a visual augmentation experiment does not remove lexical shift.

sources.title: Who Needs Labels? Adapting Vision Foundation Models With the Metadata You Already Have
sources.access: Primary abstract and PDF retrieval; no independent code execution or transfer evaluation
sources.contribution: Metadata-guided self-supervised representation adaptation in scientific domains.
sources.limit: No demonstrated Voynich decoding; section/hand metadata can preserve confounds. NOT_RUN here.

sources.title: Spatial context-based Self-Supervised Learning for Handwritten Text Recognition
sources.access: Indexed primary publisher abstract; direct full text 403
sources.limit: No transfer performance on these manuscripts verified; incomplete bibliographic fields left unset.

sources.title: Uncertainty-Aware Processing for OCR Using Dictionary Routing and Candidate Selection
sources.access: Indexed primary abstract; direct page timed out
sources.limit: Dictionary-assisted correction may hide unseen-word failure; not adopted as evidence of lexical recovery.

sources.title: Kraken 7.1 recognition datasets and default augmentation
sources.access: Full source inspected; installed source and recipe recorded by each training job
sources.contribution: Controlled common augmentation baseline with global probability 0.5 and maximum three operations.
sources.limit: Default augmentation is not a novel algorithm or independently validated glyph preservation.

sources.title: Voynichese Data Sets
sources.contribution: Semi-automated spatial binding, EVA conventions and uncertain word boundaries.
sources.limit: XML/JSON agreement is not independent expert agreement; estimated source error is not measured accuracy of this dataset.

sources.title: Connectionist Temporal Classification: Labelling Unsegmented Sequence Data with Recurrent Neural Networks
sources.authors: Alex Graves; Santiago Fernandez; Faustino Gomez; Jurgen Schmidhuber
sources.contribution: CTC likelihood sums alignments; establishes the standard objective and distinction from decoding paths.
sources.limit: Recognizing an EVA string does not identify its language or meaning.
